title: XX. Of the Authority of the Church.

segments.text: THe Church hath Power to decree Rites or Ceremonies, and Authority in Controverſies of Faith: And yet it is not lawful for the Church to ordain any thing that is contrary to God's Word written, neither may it ſo expound one place of Scripture, that it be repugnant to another. Wherefore although the Church be a Witneſs and a Keeper of Holy Writt, yet as it ought not to decree any thing againſt the ſame, ſo beſides the ſame ought it not to enforce any thing to believed for neceſſity of Salvation.
